items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: we went out for Joe Sagal to form a quartet. We played at the Jazz Showcase

ctx.x: Segal wrote the liner notes. Joe, Seegle ...
Yeah, Joe was in on it -- quite a few of the names out there.
Well, he says he went back with Johnny Griffin from his teenage years.
